requiredConsumers.rootDeath: All four DIE_DAMAGE_EFFECT children use DEPT_DIE_POS=4; saved live land XYZ, not dead mesh position nor just landY
requiredConsumers.landInitialValue: Harpoon root does not set SetLandHeightOnStart: saved vector starts [0,0,0]; live CrashLand refresh stores full radius90 native query
requiredConsumers.followLine: CanDown radius30; copy line yaw into mesh and movement axis; FOLLOW_LINE_NEW snaps only within150; MUST_ON_LINE stops at gap>200 or no line
requiredConsumers.timedChildren: Original EventTimerGlobal, source loop interval/count/lifetime bound; AUTO_DIE is child stage-cleanup ownership
requiredConsumers.burstPool: CREATE_DAMAGE multiplicity is bounded by source loop count, strict loop end and live main-mesh lifetime. Harpoon one-second carrier yields eight 0.13-second children per branch. Equipped Giga sums sixteen source flame sets with two finishing directions; normal/overheat are alternatives
requiredConsumers.presentation: Normal0.4333333373 shell animation; original RGBA jump at0.05; original shell velocity [1500,-2600,0]; all source scale/rotation curves retained
requiredConsumers.passive: PASSIVE updates SetParticleData every frame even with TRACE0; TIME trace is conditional; PT_MESH source rendering ignores Stretch
requiredConsumers.sequenceAxes: SetParticleData refreshes sequence AxisAngle/AddRotate. New particles copy both; existing template Trace particles update only movement axis after current packet movement. Old visual AddRotate and DirSpeed orientation stay at birth
requiredConsumers.particleBindings: DEPT_UNIT_BONE always sets owner rotation plus entry rotation as movement axis, even when APPLY_ROTATE=0; AddRotate remains gated. Offset is consumed only by DEPT_BONE, not unit-bone, impact or main-position. APPLY_ROTATED_OFFSET uses main mesh GetDirVec projected horizontally, not owner facing or particle entry rotation
requiredConsumers.attackMeshTransforms: ASSAULT literal Size fade and Z20 rotation, and Stone Size [.3,.6,.45] and Y90 rotation, apply to both original helper positions/radii and rendered mesh. Expectations are independently calculated from raw events and original helper poses
